name: repo
description: Pick a GitHub repo at session start or with /repo: fuzzy-match your repos, clone if missing, cd into it, and keep it as the session's active repo.

owner.title: GitHub owner
owner.description: User or org whose repos to list. Empty: whoever is logged in to gh.

cloneDir.title: Clone folder
cloneDir.description: Where missing repos are cloned. Empty: ~/repos.

openOnStart.title: Open picker on start
openOnStart.description: Open the repo picker when a session starts with no active repo.
